review.why: Plans and drafts organic posts, threads, carousels and short videos for five platforms, with drafts-first publishing.
review.summary: Covers goals, audience and voice, a platform quick reference, content pillars, hook formulas, a repurposing system for blogs, podcasts, webinars and newsletters, a weekly calendar, engagement routines, metrics and short-form video structures. Scheduling through a connected tool creates drafts first and never publishes without an explicit go-ahead.
strengths: Build-in-public posts may use only numbers found in the commits or given by the developer
Social-specific AI tells: broetry, engagement bait, manufactured vulnerability
cautions: Wide scope; ten reference files, including algorithm notes that date quickly, are not read here
Platform frequency and reach advice is generic rule of thumb
Needs a scheduling tool with its own connector for direct posting
